finding: Default severity labels 'Info:', 'Success:', 'Warning:', 'Error:' are hardcoded English strings in _defaultSeverityLabel(). Property override exists via severityLabel but only accepts a single string, not a per-variant map.
suggestion: The severityLabel property provides i18n override. Document this property prominently for consumers. Consider accepting a Record<string,string> for per-variant labels.

finding: Close button aria-label uses hardcoded template: `Close ${heading} alert`. The words 'Close' and 'alert' are not overridable.
suggestion: Add a labelClose property (like hx-dialog and hx-drawer) to allow consumers to provide localized close button label.

finding: border-left used for accent stripe: `border-left: var(--hx-alert-accent-width, 4px) solid ...`. In RTL layouts, the accent should appear on the right side.
suggestion: Replace border-left with border-inline-start to support RTL layouts.

finding: margin-left: auto used to push close button to the end. In RTL, this should be margin-inline-start.
suggestion: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

finding: margin-left: auto used to push close button. In RTL, this should be margin-inline-start.
suggestion: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

finding: margin-left: calc(-1 * ...) used for overlapping borders. In RTL layouts, this collapses the wrong side.
suggestion: Replace margin-left with margin-inline-start.

finding: 12 instances of padding-left and padding-right used across compact, heading, footer, and actions sections (lines 57-159). All should use logical properties.
suggestion: Replace all padding-left with padding-inline-start and padding-right with padding-inline-end. Affected lines: 57, 58, 62, 64, 68, 70, 130, 132, 148, 150, 157, 159.

finding: Default label 'Carousel' is hardcoded English. Property override exists via label.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — property override available. Document for consumers.

finding: Default labels 'Previous slide', 'Next slide', 'Pause autoplay', 'Play autoplay' are hardcoded English. All have property overrides.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — labelPrevSlide, labelNextSlide, labelPauseAutoplay, labelPlayAutoplay properties available. Document for consumers.

finding: 4 instances of padding-left used for label offset relative to checkbox (lines 168, 177, 195, 209). In RTL, the checkbox should be on the right with padding on the right.
suggestion: Replace all padding-left with padding-inline-start.

finding: border-left used for accent stripe (line 40) and border-left-width override for emergent status (line 100). In RTL, accent should appear on the right.
suggestion: Replace border-left with border-inline-start and border-left-width with border-inline-start-width.

finding: margin-left: auto used to push actions to the end.
suggestion: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

finding: Default labels 'Copy code', 'Copied!', 'Show more', 'Show less' are hardcoded English. All have property overrides (labelCopy, labelCopied, labelShowMore, labelShowLess).
suggestion: Baseline compliant — property overrides available. Document for consumers.

finding: Fallback aria-label 'Code snippet' is hardcoded when no language is specified.
suggestion: Add a labelFallback property or use the label property as fallback for the aria-label.

finding: padding-right used for line number gutter spacing.
suggestion: Replace padding-right with padding-inline-end.

finding: text-align: right used for line numbers. In RTL, line numbers should still be right-aligned, but text-align: end handles both correctly.
suggestion: Replace text-align: right with text-align: end.

finding: 8 default labels (labelGradient, labelHue, labelOpacity, labelSwatches, labelSwitchFormat, labelColorValue, labelPicker, labelTrigger) are hardcoded English. All have property overrides.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — all 8 label properties available. Document for consumers.

finding: Validation message 'Please select a color.' is a hardcoded fallback when no error property is set.
suggestion: Add a labelValidation or labelRequired property to allow localized validation messages.

finding: aria-valuetext uses hardcoded template: `Saturation ${s}%, Value ${v}%`. The words 'Saturation' and 'Value' are not overridable.
suggestion: Add a labelGradientValue function property to format the gradient aria-valuetext.

finding: title='Switch format' is hardcoded. The labelSwitchFormat property exists but is used for aria-label, not the visible title.
suggestion: Use labelSwitchFormat for the title attribute as well, or remove the hardcoded title.

finding: Default labels 'No options found', 'Please select an option.', 'Remove ${label}' are hardcoded English. All have property overrides (labelNoOptions, labelRequired, labelRemoveOption).
suggestion: Baseline compliant — property overrides available. Document for consumers.

finding: margin-left: auto and margin-right: auto used for centering (lines 48-49), plus padding-left and padding-right for gutters (lines 50-51). All should use logical properties.
suggestion: Replace margin-left/right: auto with margin-inline: auto (shorthand). Replace padding-left/right with padding-inline-start/end or padding-inline shorthand.

finding: Default label 'Copy to clipboard' and labelCopied 'Copied' are hardcoded English. Both have property overrides.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — label and labelCopied properties available.

finding: Error message 'Copy failed' is hardcoded with no property override.
suggestion: Add a labelError property to allow consumers to localize the copy failure message.

finding: Number formatting uses toLocaleString() without explicit locale parameter. While this defaults to browser locale, it offers no control over formatting options. Prefix/suffix properties ($, %, etc.) don't respect locale-specific positioning.
suggestion: Add a locale property. Use Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options) for explicit locale control. Consider currency formatting that respects locale conventions (e.g., 100€ vs $100).

finding: Default emptyLabel 'No data' and selectAllLabel 'Select all rows' are hardcoded English. Both have property overrides.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — emptyLabel and selectAllLabel properties available.

finding: Sort button aria-label uses hardcoded template: `Sort by ${col.label}, currently sorted ascending/descending`. The words 'Sort by', 'currently sorted', 'ascending', 'descending' are not overridable.
suggestion: Add a labelSort function property accepting (column, direction) to allow localized sort button labels.

finding: Row checkbox aria-label uses hardcoded template: `Select row ${index}`. The words 'Select row' are not overridable.
suggestion: Add a labelSelectRow function property accepting (rowIndex) to allow localized row selection labels.

finding: Table element aria-label falls back to hardcoded 'Table' when label is empty.
suggestion: Add explicit documentation that the label property must be set for i18n. Consider a required-label warning pattern.

finding: Calendar layout hardcodes Sunday as first day of week via getDay() (returns 0=Sunday). Most European, Asian, and Middle Eastern locales start weeks on Monday (ISO 8601). Home/End keyboard navigation also hardcoded to Sunday/Saturday (lines 800-815).
suggestion: Add a firstDayOfWeek property or derive it from locale using Intl.Locale.getWeekInfo(). Adjust leadingBlanks calculation and Home/End key behavior accordingly.

finding: Calendar keyboard navigation hardcodes ArrowLeft=-1 day, ArrowRight=+1 day. In RTL layouts (Arabic, Hebrew), ArrowLeft should move forward and ArrowRight backward.
suggestion: Detect dir from computed style or host attribute. In RTL: swap ArrowLeft/ArrowRight day delta. Also verify month navigation chevron icons flip correctly.

finding: Default labelClose 'Close dialog' is hardcoded English. Property override exists via labelClose.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — labelClose property available. Document for consumers.

finding: Fallback aria-label 'Dialog' is hardcoded when no label/heading is set.
suggestion: Add a labelFallback property or document that label is required for i18n.

finding: margin-left: auto used to push close button to the end.
suggestion: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

finding: Default labelClose 'Close drawer' is hardcoded English. Property override exists via labelClose.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — labelClose property available.

finding: Fallback aria-label 'Drawer' is hardcoded when no label/heading is set.
suggestion: Add a labelFallback property or document that label is required for i18n.

finding: Hardcoded aria-label='Menu' on the dropdown panel with no property override.
suggestion: Add a label property to hx-dropdown to allow consumers to localize the menu aria-label.

finding: Default labelDropzone 'Drag files here or click to browse' and labelFileList 'Selected files' are hardcoded English. Both have property overrides plus slot override for dropzone.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — labelDropzone, labelFileList properties and default slot available.

finding: File size formatting uses toFixed(1) with hardcoded unit strings 'B', 'KB', 'MB'. These unit abbreviations are English and the number format doesn't respect locale decimal separators.
suggestion: Use Intl.NumberFormat for the numeric portion. Add a labelFileSize function property or use standard file size formatting with locale support. Consider exposing unit labels as overridable.

finding: Max file size error message uses toFixed(1) with hardcoded 'MB' suffix for the size limit display.
suggestion: Use locale-aware number formatting and expose the error message template via a labelMaxSizeError property.

finding: Drag detection live region text 'File detected. Release to upload.' is hardcoded with no property override.
suggestion: Add a labelDragDetected property to allow consumers to localize this screen reader announcement.

finding: Fallback aria-label 'Menu' is hardcoded when label property is not set.
suggestion: Document that the label property must be set for i18n. Consider removing the fallback to force consumers to provide a localized label.

finding: text-align: left used for nav link text alignment.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: padding-left used for nav item indentation (lines 173, 226).
suggestion: Replace padding-left with padding-inline-start.

finding: border-left used as divider between input and stepper buttons.
suggestion: Replace border-left with border-inline-start.

finding: Default labels 'More actions' and 'Actions' are hardcoded English. Both have property overrides (label, labelMenu).
suggestion: Baseline compliant — label and labelMenu properties available.

finding: text-align: left used for menu item text.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: 8 default labels (label, labelRowsPerPage, firstPageLabel, previousPageLabel, nextPageLabel, lastPageLabel, and functions) are hardcoded English. All have property overrides.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — all label properties available. Document for consumers.

finding: Live region announcement `Page ${clamped} of ${totalPages}` uses hardcoded English template with no property override.
suggestion: Add a labelPageMessage function property: (current: number, total: number) => string to allow localized page navigation announcements.

finding: Page button aria-labels use hardcoded template `Page ${page}` with no override mechanism.
suggestion: Add a labelPageButton function property: (page: number) => string for localized page button labels.

finding: Validation message 'Please select an option.' is hardcoded fallback when no error property is set. No dedicated property override for this message.
suggestion: Add a labelRequired property to allow consumers to localize the default validation message.

finding: Empty state text 'No options found' is hardcoded in render() with no property or slot override.
suggestion: Add a labelNoOptions property (matching hx-combobox pattern) and/or an empty-label slot.

finding: text-align: left used for select trigger text alignment.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: border-right used for chevron indicator styling.
suggestion: Replace border-right with border-inline-end.

finding: text-align: left used for nav item text.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: margin-left: auto used twice (lines 119, 130) for badge/indicator alignment.
suggestion: Replace margin-left: auto with margin-inline-start: auto.

finding: padding-left used for nested nav item indentation.
suggestion: Replace padding-left with padding-inline-start for proper RTL nesting.

finding: text-align: right used for max value label.
suggestion: Replace text-align: right with text-align: end.

finding: Default label 'Loading' is hardcoded English. Property override exists via label.
suggestion: Baseline compliant — label property available.

finding: border-right: none and border-left used for divider between primary and dropdown buttons (lines 30, 79).
suggestion: Replace border-right with border-inline-end and border-left with border-inline-start.

finding: Trend indicator aria-label uses hardcoded template `Trend: ${this.trend}`. The word 'Trend' is not overridable via any property.
suggestion: Add a labelTrend property or function to allow localized trend description.

finding: text-align: left used for step content text alignment.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: text-align: left used for table cell text alignment.
suggestion: Replace text-align: left with text-align: start.

finding: Character counter uses this.value.length which counts UTF-16 code units, not user-perceived characters. Emoji like '👨‍👩‍👧‍👦' (family emoji) has .length of 11 but is 1 visible character. Counter announcement says wrong count.
suggestion: Use Intl.Segmenter (or Array.from(value).length as fallback) for accurate grapheme counting in the character counter announcement.

finding: text-align: right used for character counter alignment.
suggestion: Replace text-align: right with text-align: end.

finding: padding-left used for tree item indentation based on nesting level. In RTL, indentation should be on the right side.
suggestion: Replace padding-left with padding-inline-start for proper RTL tree indentation.

finding: Ellipsis button aria-label 'Show all breadcrumb items' is hardcoded with no property override.
suggestion: Add a labelEllipsis property to allow consumers to localize the expand button label.
